title: Broughton returns with a wonderful hit single "Love Race Interlude"
htmlContent:
Broughton returns with a wonderful hit single called "Love Race Interlude," a smash that you feel in a real way on his new song. It’s a honest, and daring piece of audio that shows the true art of music. Broughton’s talents are on full display with everything being done at a stellar level on this track that makes it must hear.

Broughton's Love Race Interlude is amazing music that showcases his art to the fullest. The record dares to be great and pulls it off majorly, with each moving element coming together to make a work of art anyone who listens, will enjoy the fullest.
